understanding.goal_understanding: Reach the goal gem tile marked + in each level and continue until the game is won, while avoiding spike tiles.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: MOVE_LEFT and MOVE_RIGHT shift horizontally, then gravity automatically carries the player until landing or reaching a hazard or goal. Gravity direction determines whether the player falls toward smaller or larger y-values. CLICK at a target position removes clickable breakable blocks without moving the player, and UNDO reverts the previous action. Landing on spikes ends the attempt; each level allows two attempts with a limited turn budget.
